summary: Kaniksu National Forest tower built in 1935 as a 30-foot pole with an L-4 cab and destroyed in 1955; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1955; one Idaho register lists it as removed.

evidence.supports: about 14 miles north-northeast of Bonners Ferry
built 1935 as a 30-foot pole L-4 tower; destroyed 1955
built 1935 as a 30-foot pole tower with L-4 cab
register uses the word Removed for the tower
Boundary County; tower; listed as gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Idaho register says Removed; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed in 1955. All three describe the tower as gone, so the story uses destroyed with the 1955 date.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Two lookout histories agree on 1935 and 1955; the Idaho register says Removed with no date. No staffing, cause of loss or present-day site description found. Only one search was run. The Rex's Fire Lookout Page that the register cites was not located. The brief's gone status, Boundary County and Kaniksu agency all check out. Verified 2026-10-10: story wording changed from regional to Idaho register; cite 2 year quotes added for 1935 and 1955.
